design_archetype: The Performance Pro & Tactical Command Center (Polished Light Theme)

background_patterns: Subtle 24px grid overlay with low opacity (`bg-[radial-gradient(#e2e8f0_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:16px_16px]`)
Soft animated blue ambient gradient blob in top right header background (`bg-gradient-to-tr from-blue-50/40 via-indigo-50/20 to-transparent`)

card_styles.default: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl shadow-[0_1px_3px_0_rgba(15,23,42,0.03),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgba(15,23,42,0.03)] hover:shadow-md hover:border-slate-300 transition-all duration-200
card_styles.kpi: relative overflow-hidden bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 group
card_styles.highlight: bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-slate-50/50 to-blue-50/30 border border-blue-100 rounded-xl shadow-sm

visual_enhancers.drag_drop_upload: border-2 border-dashed border-blue-200 hover:border-blue-500 bg-blue-50/30 hover:bg-blue-50/60 transition-all duration-200 rounded-xl p-8 text-center cursor-pointer

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-5
grids_and_layouts.funnel_visualizer: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2
grids_and_layouts.mobile_table_card_pattern: hidden md:table for desktop, grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:hidden for mobile

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text against backgrounds
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, candidate rows, modals, navigation links) MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain all existing APIs, endpoints, state variables, user roles (HR, Management, Admin), and workflow logic.
Elevate the visual styling of all 8 KPI cards with subtle background SVG accent graphics, sleek iconography, hover lift effects, and crisp typography.
Enhance the candidate recruitment funnel visualizer with step connections, active count pill badges, and smooth progress styling.
Upgrade the Candidate Profile header with sleek avatar badges, quick action triggers, and a vertical append-only HR updates timeline featuring timestamp dots, user avatars, and status change tags.
Refine the Drag & Drop resume upload area with an inviting dotted dropzone, clear upload indicators, progress states, and file preview/download actions.
Ensure mobile responsiveness: tables convert gracefully to touch-friendly cards on small screens, sidebar converts to drawer menu, single-column forms.
Incorporate Skeleton Loaders for data fetching states and polished empty states with subtle Lucide iconography for empty queues or search results.
Ensure every single interactive element, link, form input, button, table cell trigger, modal action, and status badge maintains accurate data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use generic unstyled tables or plain default inputs.
DO NOT use full screen dark gradients; maintain the crisp light command center theme.
DO NOT apply transition: all globally. Specify transition-color, opacity, or transform explicitly.
ALWAYS explicit hover text color when hover background changes.
ALWAYS ensure data-testid is present on interactive components for stable test automation.
